chat.text: Indeed, please reject/accept as soon as possible IoT-directorate review request

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text:
I would like to briefly highlight a few ongoing security standardization activities that may be relevant to the IoT community.
First, we are completing the work on the updated TLS/DTLS 1.3 profile for IoT devices in the UTA working group. This document updates the recommendations from RFC 7925. We are currently in the IESG review phase and have responded to all comments.
Second, there is ongoing work in COSE on post-quantum cryptography, including key encapsulation and HPKE. Some of the documents are quite far long already. There are others, like FN-DSA for COSE, is obviously blocked by NIST.
Finally, there is ongoing work on integrating remote attestation into certificate enrollment. The CSR attestation draft is further along and currently in IESG review. The freshness draft is close to WGLC.
